tasks.title: Color-only picking
tasks.description: Pick only the requested color of well-separated cubes from a slowly moving conveyor and place them into one target bin. Leave other objects on the belt.

tasks.title: Faster conveyor
tasks.description: Select the requested color while the conveyor moves faster and the reachable picking window is shorter.

tasks.title: Denser object stream
tasks.description: Pick target-colored objects when targets and distractors arrive closer together.

tasks.title: Color and shape selection
tasks.description: Pick objects satisfying a color-and-shape rule, such as red cubes but not red cylinders or blue cubes.

tasks.title: Size-based selection
tasks.description: Pick objects matching a stated color and size criterion while similar-looking distractors continue past the robot.

tasks.title: Instruction-conditioned selection
tasks.description: Choose objects according to an explicit combination of visible properties that changes between episodes, not during an episode.

tasks.title: Multiple destination bins
tasks.description: Sort selected object categories into their specified bins, such as red objects into one bin and blue objects into another, while ignoring other objects.

tasks.title: Combined timing and visual ambiguity
tasks.description: Combine validated faster motion, denser arrivals and genuine object occlusion with an explicit visual selection rule.

tasks.title: Swinging crane hook capture
tasks.description: Capture an independently swinging crane hook with a robot gripper, guide it through a load eye, and establish stable support without excessive impacts.

tasks.title: Larger hook swing
tasks.description: Increase the hook's initial swing amplitude within a validated release range while keeping the suspension, robot and load eye unchanged.

tasks.title: Different swing phase
tasks.description: Start the same-amplitude hook swing at different physically consistent combinations of angle and angular velocity, so the robot must observe its approach rather than reuse one capture time.

tasks.title: Out-of-plane hook swing
tasks.description: Introduce an initial swing with motion in more than one spatial plane, requiring the gripper to intercept a three-dimensional approach.

tasks.title: Offset or rotated load eye
tasks.description: Place the load eye at different reachable positions and orientations, so a captured hook must be guided into a changed engagement pose.

tasks.title: Hook orientation and twist
tasks.description: Vary the initial orientation or torsional state of an asymmetric hook so engagement requires aligning the hook with the load eye.

tasks.title: Bounded disturbance during capture
tasks.description: Apply a bounded owner-side disturbance through an explicitly modeled physical force while the hook swings, without giving the solver control of that disturbance.

tasks.title: Combined swing and engagement variation
tasks.description: Combine individually validated swing amplitude, phase, hook orientation and load-eye placement variations in one capture-and-engagement episode.

tasks.title: Humanoid step-and-catch pilot
tasks.description: An independently actuated donor arm physically throws a rigid package; a free-base humanoid must take a feasible step, catch it and remain balanced while retaining it.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch at different receiving offsets
tasks.description: Vary validated physical donor throws toward different reachable receiving locations, requiring the humanoid to choose a useful step direction and coordinate its arms with its changing support.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch with different flight times
tasks.description: Vary validated donor actuation to produce different flight times and arrival speeds, requiring the humanoid to coordinate its step, hand interception and impact recovery.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch of a spinning package
tasks.description: Use physically attainable donor release orientations and spins so the stepping humanoid must align its grasp and manage the resulting contact while balancing.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch with uncertain release timing
tasks.description: Vary when the donor physically begins its throw within a declared window, requiring the humanoid to maintain readiness and use visible cues to time stepping and interception.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch from different starting stances
tasks.description: Reset the humanoid to different legal, initially supportable foot placements and whole-body joint configurations before a nominal throw, changing its preparation and stepping strategy.

tasks.title: Humanoid catch with qualified package loads
tasks.description: Use prequalified package mass and inertia profiles with the same external geometry, requiring the humanoid to absorb different incoming momentum and stabilize the retained load.

tasks.title: Combined humanoid step-and-catch variation
tasks.description: Combine individually validated throw offsets, release timing, package spin/load and humanoid starting stances while retaining physical stepping, catching and post-impact balance requirements.

tasks.title: Tilting marble maze with moving gates
tasks.description: Tilt a maze board to guide a rolling marble through independently moving gates into its assigned hole, without losing it through other openings.

tasks.title: Different marble starting areas
tasks.description: Reset the marble in different reachable starting regions of the same maze while retaining the same target hole and gate mechanism.

tasks.title: Different gate phase
tasks.description: Start the independently actuated gate at different physically consistent phases of its existing motion, changing when the marble can pass.

tasks.title: Different gate cycle speeds
tasks.description: Vary the gate's validated actuator drive rate so passage windows change while its geometry, mass and contact settings remain fixed.

tasks.title: Initial rolling momentum
tasks.description: Start the marble with different physically valid rolling states, requiring the controller to brake or redirect existing momentum rather than begin from rest.

tasks.title: Two-marble coordination
tasks.description: Place two identical qualified marbles in the maze and require both to reach permitted destination holes, so one board tilt affects two interacting objects.

tasks.title: Color-conditioned destinations
tasks.description: Route multiple colored marbles to explicitly assigned existing destination holes, with the color-to-hole mapping fixed and visible before the episode starts.

tasks.title: Combined gate and multi-marble variation
tasks.description: Combine validated starting regions, rolling momentum, gate phases/rates and multi-marble destination rules while the same board actuators control all marbles.

tasks.title: Vision-only pinball target sequence
tasks.description: Control two flippers to direct a moving ball into visible targets in a requested order before it drains from the table.

tasks.title: Variable physical serve
tasks.description: Vary validated initial launch conditions or plunger drive settings so the ball enters play along different physically generated approaches.

tasks.title: Different target orders
tasks.description: Ask for different explicit orders of hits on the table's existing reachable targets, requiring changes in shot selection rather than new mechanics.

tasks.title: Longer target sequences
tasks.description: Require longer sequences involving existing targets, including physically separate revisits where feasible, before the ball drains.

tasks.title: Higher-energy serve
tasks.description: Use higher but validated physical launcher energy to create faster incoming motion and different rebound timing without changing gravity or the flippers.

tasks.title: Asymmetric flipper starts
tasks.description: Reset the two flippers to different legal angles before a nominal serve, requiring the controller to recover a useful interception configuration.

tasks.title: Controlled finish after target hits
tasks.description: After completing a short target sequence, physically settle or cradle the ball in a declared reachable flipper region for a finite interval instead of immediately losing it.

tasks.title: Combined serve and target variation
tasks.description: Combine validated serve conditions, flipper start poses and target sequences, with an explicitly declared controlled-finish requirement only where separately qualified.
